# shim-cli

> Local hooks and an opt-in measuring proxy for coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot CLI, VS Code): reports or masks secrets and personal data in prompts and tool traffic, and measures what a session sent and cost.

What it cannot do: a prompt typed into Claude Code or Codex cannot be masked, because neither client lets a hook rewrite it; shim reports it, or blocks it with `user-prompt = "enforce"` under `[mode]` in the settings file. GitHub Copilot CLI replaces the prompt the model sees. Windows is not supported; use WSL, macOS or Linux.

What it does when it cannot inspect: from 1.2.2 it fails closed in every mode. The prompt is withheld, a tool call refused, and a Claude Code tool result withheld; where the client allows neither, the user and the model are told. An agent's attempt to change shim's settings or hooks, or to run `shim config` or `shim revert`, is refused; run those yourself.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/GetSHIM/shim-cli/blob/main/README.md): what shim-cli does, install, the supported clients and what each one lets shim change
- [Command reference](https://github.com/GetSHIM/shim-cli/blob/main/docs/commands.md): every command, flag, exit code, JSON error code and settings key
- [Cookbook](https://github.com/GetSHIM/shim-cli/blob/main/docs/cookbook.md): recipes, including letting an agent run shim, blocking a secret before it leaves, CI and scripts
- [Findings](https://github.com/GetSHIM/shim-cli/blob/main/docs/findings.md): the `findings` list of `shim doctor`, `shim report` and `shim watch` with `--json`, every rule, what it means and what to do
- [Privacy](https://github.com/GetSHIM/shim-cli/blob/main/docs/privacy.md): what is recorded, what leaves the machine, and the limits of a best-effort guard
- [Compatibility](https://github.com/GetSHIM/shim-cli/blob/main/docs/compatibility.md): tested client versions, live evidence and detector parity with the gateway
- [Architecture](https://github.com/GetSHIM/shim-cli/blob/main/docs/architecture.md): the hook, the detector and the `shim watch` proxy, and who owns what
